model: Four independent proper imputations of the SAME incomplete study. Each record is an estimate of the same scalar population contrast and its estimated complete-data sampling VARIANCE,not standard error. These are not four independent newly sampled studies. Complete-data degrees of freedom are taken infinite;use the conventional Rubin repeated-imputation pooling and its original large-complete-sample finite-imputation tdegrees of freedom,not a small-complete-sample correction.
target: Return pooled estimate,mean within-imputation variance,sample between-imputation variance,total pooled variance,pooled standard error,and Rubin finite-imputation degrees of freedom. Also calculate the variance reported by the incorrect shortcut that treats the four completed-data estimates as independent measurements with variances U_i and averages them with equal weights,then state whether it understates the required pooled variance.
scope: No actual missing-data mechanism or imputation validity is inferred from these summaries;proper-imputation assumptions are stipulated. Duplicate copies of records are not additional independent imputations. Units of all estimates match;variance units are their square.

provenance.kind: Explicit controlled statistical study with stated working assumptions;not empirical population evidence.
